Context & Usage Monitor

A 100% read-only, zero-injection plugin for Google Antigravity (Desktop & CLI) — live context pressure, Prompt Cache savings, output speed (tok/s), First Token Latency (TTFT), and a 12-week heatmap.

English | 简体中文

--- ## Why This Plugin? - **No more surprise `256K` compactions**: Most flagship models auto-compact near `256K` (`CHECKPOINT`), not `1M`. **`Auto` mode calibrates directly to `256K` by default** and adapts via observed `CHECKPOINT` peaks and model hints, so you know right when to `/compact`. - **See what bloated your context**: Splits usage into **Base** vs. **Growth** tokens and attributes per-turn and per-tool (`read_file`, `run_command`, etc.) deltas. - **Know if it's thinking or lagging**: Tracks both session average and latest-step **First Token Latency (`Avg / Last TTFT`)** alongside **End-to-End Output Speed (`Avg / Last tok/s`)**. - **Track Cache savings & total usage**: Shows live Prompt Cache hit rate, reference API cost/savings (`USD` / `CNY`), and an **84-day activity heatmap** combining **Antigravity Desktop + CLI**. - **Zero app mods, zero risk**: Pure official plugin — `0` extra prompt tokens, Apple code signatures stay intact, and survives every Antigravity client update. --- ## Preview


macOS Titlebar Capsule & Session Popover — Auto (256K) gauge, Base/Growth breakdown, Avg / Last tok/s, Avg / Last TTFT, and session switcher


Global History & 12-Week Heatmap — Desktop + CLI totals
Instant Settings — English / 中文, position, density & limit


Cross-Platform Auxiliary Pane Web UI — Overview (with TTFT & Speed cards), History, Steps, Tools, and Raw

> **Two ways to inspect**: On macOS, left-click the floating titlebar capsule to open the 3-tab popover (right-click for quick controls, drag to reposition). On **all platforms**, click **`+` → Context & Usage** in any conversation header to open the Auxiliary Pane. --- ## Quick Install ```bash git clone https://github.com/heywalter/antigravity-context-monitor.git \ ~/.gemini/config/plugins/context-monitor ``` Restart Antigravity (or enable **Context & Usage** in **Customizations**), or validate/install via CLI (`agy plugin validate . && agy plugin install .`). On macOS, `hud_bar.swift` auto-compiles locally on first launch when `swiftc` (Xcode Command Line Tools) is installed, or skips the floating HUD cleanly while keeping the Aux Pane active. --- ## How It Works, Security & Compatibility ```mermaid flowchart LR Hook["Hook + Local Files\n(track_active.sh · transcript.jsonl · annotations · .db)"] -->|"100% Read-Only"| Sidecar["Node Sidecar\n(main · metrics · ttft · titles · prefs · history)"] Sidecar -->|"localhost via sidecar_sdk"| Aux["Aux Pane Web UI\n(macOS · Linux · Windows)"] Sidecar -->|"auto swiftc + token"| HUD["Native HUD Capsule\n(macOS AppKit)"] ``` - **100% Within Official Rules**: Uses only Antigravity's official [`plugin.json`](./plugin.json), [`hooks.json`](./hooks.json), and `sidecar_sdk` ([`sidecar.json`](./sidecars/context_monitor/sidecar.json) with `"allows_user_interactions": false`); passes `agy plugin validate` with **0 errors and 0 warnings**, and never edits `config.json`. - **Pure Local Read-Only Logic**: A minimal `SessionStart` / `PreInvocation` hook records `active_hook.json`; the sidecar reads Antigravity's own `transcript.jsonl` (tokens, checkpoints, speed), `annotations/*.pbtxt` (live & renamed titles), and read-only SQLite `conversations/*.db` (`created_at` → `viewable_at` TTFT), calibrating `Auto` limits via `256K` default, `CHECKPOINT` peaks, model hints, and overflow promotion. - **Security & Privacy**: Zero `Antigravity.app` patching, zero CDP (`--remote-debugging-port`), **zero outbound network requests** (`127.0.0.1` only), per-launch random `CONTEXT_MONITOR_HUD_TOKEN` protecting `/api/hud`, strict `ID_RE` path-traversal checks, and `{ readOnly: true }` SQLite handles ([SECURITY.md](./SECURITY.md)). - **Cross-Platform & Graceful Fallback**: Full Aux Pane UI runs on **macOS, Linux, and Windows** (`hudSupported === false` auto-hides Mac controls); macOS adds the native `arm64`/`x86_64` HUD (skips safely if `swiftc` is absent); on Node 20 without `node:sqlite`, `TTFT` falls back cleanly to `—` with zero errors; survives Antigravity app updates intact. --- ## Notes & Development - **Telemetry & Reference Cost**: Token counts are 100% raw Antigravity telemetry from `transcript.jsonl`; `TTFT` measures request start to first visible output chunk (including extended thinking). USD/CNY estimates use a static benchmark (`Input $2 / Cache $0.2 / Out $10 per 1M`, `1 USD = 7.25 CNY`) for reference intuition only.
Development & Verification Commands (zero external npm dependencies) ```bash # 1. Check hook & JS syntax sh -n hooks/track_active.sh cd sidecars/context_monitor node --check main.mjs && node --check prefs.mjs && node --check titles.mjs && node --check ttft.mjs && node --check metrics.mjs && node --check history.mjs && node --check app.js # 2. Run unit tests & validate manifests npm test cd ../.. && agy plugin validate . # 3. Build & self-test macOS Universal Binary (arm64 + x86_64) ./scripts/build-hud-universal.sh && rm -rf dist ``` Runtime data lives under `~/.gemini/antigravity/sidecar_data/context-monitor/context_monitor/` (`logs/sidecar.log`, `data/hud_prefs.json`, `data/bin/hud_bar`).

## `antigravity-context-monitor` v0.2.1

Maintenance & reliability release eliminating sidecar event log growth and hardening background runtime behavior.

### Fixed
- **Eliminated `events/` Disk Bloat (`0 B` sidecar events)**: Removed background `agentapi get-conversation-metadata` CLI fallback polling from `main.mjs`. In `v0.2.0`, polling untitled/subagent conversations every 15s caused Antigravity's `agentapi` runner to log full `conversationMetadata` JSON payloads (up to ~200 KB per subagent call) into `<sidecar_data>/events/`, growing to gigabytes over days. Title resolution now runs 100% locally via `annotations/*.pbtxt`, read-only `conversation_summaries.db`, and `transcript.jsonl` previews with zero subprocess spawns.
- **Subagent Active-Session Protection (`titles.mjs`, `main.mjs`)**: Reads `parent_conversation_id` and `nesting_depth` from `conversation_summaries.db` so background `browser` / `research` subagents no longer hijack the HUD from the active user conversation or clutter the recent-session picker (global history totals still include all Desktop + CLI transcripts).
- **SQLite Read-Only Robustness (`titles.mjs`)**: Added `{ readOnly: true, timeout: 1000 }`, switched fallback SQL to standard single-quoted `WHERE title != ''`, and preserved cached entries on transient lock errors.
- **Idle Repaint & Cache Eviction Hardening (`hud_bar.swift`, `main.mjs`, `history.mjs`, `titles.mjs`)**: Avoided redundant 4 Hz `layoutCapsuleSubviews()` / `needsDisplay` redraws in `hud_bar.swift` when window bounds and metrics are unchanged, avoided redundant `topSessions` enrichment on `/api/hud`, and replaced full-map `.clear()` calls with incremental FIFO eviction.

### Upgrading from `v0.2.0`
After updating the plugin, you can safely reclaim any legacy event logs created by `v0.2.0`:

```bash
rm -rf ~/.gemini/antigravity/sidecar_data/context-monitor/context_monitor/events
```

### Optional Prebuilt macOS Universal Binary (`hud_bar`)
macOS compiles `hud_bar.swift` automatically on first run when Xcode Command Line Tools (`swiftc`) is installed. If you prefer not to install Command Line Tools:

```bash
mkdir -p ~/.gemini/config/plugins/context-monitor/sidecars/context_monitor
tar -xzf hud_bar-v0.2.1-macos-universal.tar.gz -C ~/.gemini/config/plugins/context-monitor/sidecars/context_monitor/
```
